summary: v0.3 Phase 3 PRE-DEPLOYMENT CLEANUP regression pass. All four cleanup edits confirmed safe. Backend: 25/25 v0.3 Phase 3 pytests + 20/20 leaderboard/learn/test-mode pytests + 5/5 v0.2.5 scoring TCs (50 total tests) all pass. Frontend: /play round-mode picker, 3R start (Round 1 / 3), deep link /play?rounds=5 (Round 1 / 5), score-breakdown, simplicity-tag ('Simplicity Score: +10 / 10' green for right-sized), /learn/match start->play with Prof Flock avatar, match-submit disabled until slots filled, /leaderboard headers exactly ['#','Player','3R Best','5R Best','10R Best'], admin panel present. Mobile 390px: /play, /learn/match, /leaderboard all show scrollWidth==innerWidth (no horizontal overflow). Zero browser console errors across flows. Admin delete returned 200 with valid token from env (ADMIN_TOKEN, X-Admin-Token header); missing/invalid token returns 403. All TEST_ leaderboard rows cleaned up (0 remain post-run).
critical_code_review_comments: game_engine._simplicity now defensively initializes score=10.0 and state='right_sized' before the branch chain. All three branches (overengineered, too_thin, right_sized) still reassign both, and the return payload still exposes state and lost. Behavior confirmed identical: right-sized 3-svc pick -> state='right_sized', lost=0.0; 6-svc overengineered pick -> state='overengineered', lost>0. Safe edit.

Leaderboard.jsx legacy-migration catch now logs console.debug('cf_my_score legacy migration skipped:', err) instead of swallowing silently. No functional change; per-mode aggregation and delete flow unchanged. Zero console errors during the run.

tests/test_v03_phase3_e2e.py reads ADMIN_TOKEN via load_dotenv from /app/backend/.env and correctly pytest.skip()s admin tests if unset. No hardcoded token in the file (grepped for hex/base64 patterns, only os.environ.get lookup). Deployment-safe.
Literal comparison anti-patterns (is True/is False) were only in test files, not product code. Server.py and game_engine.py unchanged. Backend suite still green.

Prior iter6 finding still open (not in this run's scope): ScoreRequest silently drops unknown fields. Consider model_config = ConfigDict(extra='forbid') or field alias to accept both 'constraints' and 'constraint_ids'. Not a regression, informational.

ADMIN_TOKEN in /app/backend/.env is stored wrapped in shell-style quotes when read via `cut -d= -f2` from bash; Python dotenv/os.environ.get strips the quotes correctly, so runtime is fine. Only affects raw shell scripts that don't strip quotes. Not a bug.
test_credentials: Admin token read from ADMIN_TOKEN in /app/backend/.env; used as X-Admin-Token header. Admin delete returned 200 with valid token from env. No secret printed.
seed_data_creation: Two throwaway leaderboard entries created via POST /api/leaderboard (TEST_iter7_regr, TEST_iter7_admin_verify). Both admin-deleted at end of run. Final TEST_ row count in prod leaderboard: 0.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Regression quick-check: `cd /app/backend && python3 -m pytest tests/test_v03_phase3_e2e.py tests/test_v03_phase3_scoring.py tests/test_v03_match.py tests/test_v0261_leaderboard.py tests/test_v03_learn.py tests/test_v03_test_mode.py -v` (45 tests) plus `python3 -m tests.test_scoring` (5/5). Leaderboard POST fields are name/total_score (NOT player_name/score). /api/game/score uses field constraint_ids (NOT constraints) - Pydantic silently drops unknown keys. Admin delete: DELETE /api/admin/leaderboard/{id} with header X-Admin-Token. When reading ADMIN_TOKEN from .env in bash, strip surrounding quotes (`tr -d '"'`); Python dotenv handles this automatically. All four cleanup edits verified safe: defensive init in _simplicity, console.debug in Leaderboard catch, env-based ADMIN_TOKEN in tests, == instead of `is True` in test assertions.
rca of the issue: N/A - no bugs found. This was a pre-deployment cleanup regression pass and all four edits are behavior-preserving.
